title: God Hand (USA, SLUS_215.03), ee-gcc 2.96 + SN ProDG ee-gcc 2.95.3-136
setup: mkdir -p {work}/cc/linux/ee/gcc/lib/gcc-lib/ee {work}/cc/windows/ee/gcc/lib/gcc-lib/ee/2.95.3-sn-136 {work}/cc/windows/ee/gcc/lib/gcc-lib/ee/2.95.2-sn-273a tools disc_extract build && rm -rf compiler && mkdir -p compiler && ln -sfn {work}/cc/linux compiler/linux && ln -sfn {work}/cc/windows compiler/windows && G={work}/cc/linux/ee/gcc && ln -sfn {tool:ee-gcc2.96}/bin $G/bin && ln -sfn {tool:ee-gcc2.96}/ee $G/ee && ln -sfn {tool:ee-gcc2.96}/lib/gcc-lib/ee/2.96-ee-001003-1 $G/lib/gcc-lib/ee/2.96-ee-001003-1 && ln -sfn {tool:ee-gcc2.9-991111-01}/lib/gcc-lib/ee/2.9-ee-991111-01 $G/lib/gcc-lib/ee/2.9-ee-991111-01 && ln -sfn {tool:ee-gcc2.9-990721}/lib/gcc-lib/ee/2.9-ee-990721 $G/lib/gcc-lib/ee/2.9-ee-990721 && for f in {tool:ee-gcc2.95.3-136}/lib/gcc-lib/ee/2.95.3/*; do ln -sf $f {work}/cc/windows/ee/gcc/lib/gcc-lib/ee/2.95.3-sn-136/; done && ln -sf {tool:ee-gcc2.95.2-273a}/lib/gcc-lib/ee/2.95.2/ps2eeas.exe {work}/cc/windows/ee/gcc/lib/gcc-lib/ee/2.95.2-sn-273a/ps2eeas.exe && ln -sf {tool:wibo}/wibo tools/wibo && ln -sfn {work}/venv .venv
ln -sf {retail} disc_extract/SLUS_215.03 && mipsel-linux-gnu-objcopy -O binary disc_extract/SLUS_215.03 build/SLUS_215.03.rom
limits: God Hand: the repo's own build entry point (`compile.py`) is run once under tests/m22-003/tools/trace/sitecustomize.py, which records the compile commands it spawns (`scripts/ee-cc-wrap.py` / `scripts/sn-cc-wrap.py`); each unit is then compiled with its recorded command. Every compiler the repo's setup installs (Cygnus ee-gcc 2.96, SN ProDG ee-gcc 2.95.3-136, 2.9-991111-01, 2.9-990721, the 2.95.2-273a SN assembler) is the pinned `toolchains.json` package of the same name, laid out under `compiler/` as `scripts/setup_toolchain.sh` lays them out; wibo is the pinned 1.2.0 (the repo pins 0.6.13).

`--extern-jtbl SYMBOL` (a wrapper flag naming the jump table of the original function) is dropped from the command when a candidate is compiled: the wrapper aborts when the text it compiles has no such table.

SN ProDG's EE gcc 2.95.3 has a 128-bit `long long` (`sizeof(long long)` is not 8 and any arithmetic on it is "unsupported wide integer operation"): its 64-bit integer type is `long`. romwright and m2c both print the 64-bit type as `long long`, so for units compiled with that compiler the harness rewrites `long long` to `long` in the composed source (prelude, context and candidate). Without it a quarter of the candidates fail to compile whatever else they say.
